AnalysisBoxoffy Intelligence
Boxoffy · Box Office Intelligence · Updated March 2026
Three generations of Nadiadwalas in Hindi cinema. 2025 was NGE's most painful year on record — Sikandar (Salman Khan, Eid 2025) grossed only ₹103 Cr India, a near-total write-off for a ₹200+ Cr budget film. Baaghi 4 (Tiger Shroff, Sep 2025) also flopped. Only Housefull 5 (June 2025) performed — crossing ₹160 Cr India on the franchise's loyal audience. Combined losses across three major 2025 releases reached approximately ₹311 Cr. The studio is in reset mode for 2026 with Welcome to the Jungle (Jun 26) — a 30-actor ensemble comedy representing a safer bet than star-vehicle gambles.
Boxoffy Note
The Amazon Prime Video exclusive deal means every NGE theatrical film goes to Amazon post-theatrical. 2025 was an inflection point — three releases, two disasters, one moderate success. Sikandar proved Salman's star power is no longer a guarantee. NGE's 2026 reset with Welcome to the Jungle (ensemble comedy) suggests a pivot away from single-star-vehicle gambles.
